settings.title: What is melatonin?
settings.text: Melatonin is a hormone naturally produced by the pineal gland in the brain, primarily responsible for regulating the body's circadian rhythm to manage the natural sleep cycle. Often referred to as the "sleep hormone," melatonin levels rise in the evening to promote sleep and decrease in the morning to help wake up. It’s widely used as a dietary supplement to treat sleep disorders, such as insomnia or jet lag. Melatonin supplements are favored for their natural approach to improving sleep quality.

settings.title: Are CBD gummies good for sleeping?
settings.text: CBD gummies have the potential to support sleep, but individual experiences may vary. CBD interacts with the endocannabinoid system, which plays a role in regulating sleep-wake cycles. Some individuals report that CBD gummies help promote relaxation and improve sleep quality, while others may not experience the same effects. If you are considering CBD gummies for sleep support, it's recommended to start with a low dose and monitor how your body responds. Additionally, establishing healthy sleep habits, such as maintaining a consistent sleep schedule and creating a conducive sleep environment, can also contribute to better sleep.

settings.title: Is CBD or CBN better for sleep?
settings.text: Both CBD and CBN have potential benefits for sleep, and their effectiveness can depend on individual factors such as metabolism and the specific product used. CBD may promote relaxation and calmness, potentially helping to alleviate stress and anxiety, whereas CBN may have sedative effects that can promote sleepiness. However, more research is needed before conclusive claims can be made. NextEvo Naturals focuses on offering high-quality CBD products in line with promoting a healthy sleep routine.

settings.title: What are the side effects of CBD sleep gummies?
settings.text: Side effects of CBD sleep gummies may include drowsiness or sedation, particularly at higher doses. Users might also experience dry mouth, digestive discomfort, or mild nausea. If the gummies contain additional sleep aids like melatonin, side effects can also include changes in sleep patterns or morning grogginess. It's important to start with a low dose and monitor how your body reacts, especially if combining with other sleep medications or supplements. Always consult a healthcare provider before starting any new supplement regimen.
